articles.title_en: Gasoline prices suddenly fell in Russia’s Krasnoyarsk Krai ahead of a possible Putin visit
articles.lead_en: Fuel prices at gas stations in Russia’s Krasnoyarsk Krai dropped by more than 20 rubles on the evening of August 2, correspondents for the news outlet NGS24 reported. The price cuts affected stations run by the regional chain Krasnoyarsknefteprodukt.

articles.title_en: Forbes Russia: Wildberries sellers’ losses from Ukrainian warehouse strikes estimated at 215-280 billion rubles
articles.lead_en: Sellers on Wildberries may have lost as much as 215–280 billion rubles because of Ukrainian drone strikes on the company’s warehouses, according to an estimate Sergei Semko, lead analyst at the research agency Data Insight, shared with Forbes Russia.

articles.title_en: Ukraine says online retail giant Wildberries helps supply Russia’s military. Meduza examines the evidence.
articles.lead_en: Since July 18, Ukraine has struck Wildberries continuously. Kyiv says the warehouses and logistics centers are used to supply “sanctioned components for drone production and navigation equipment.” There is no information that Wildberries is systematically embedded in the infrastructure of Russia’s Defense Ministry — but it is known that volunteers helping the army buy goods on the marketplace.
